contract: PATCH /api/podcasts/:id/episode/:episodeId updates supported episode fields, sanitizes text, and answers the expanded library item.
exceptions: normal, error and edge facets are covered by the listed scenarios.
force is not applicable: PATCH has no force/hard/override parameter; the hard delete route is the force mode of episode removal.

invariants.contract: PATCH /api/podcasts/:id/episode/:episodeId stores the supported string fields (title, subtitle, description, pubDate, episode, season, episodeType) after sanitizing description and subtitle HTML to the allowed tags and attributes, stores a numeric publishedAt, stores an enclosure object as URL/type/length, stores chapters only when every chapter has a title and a truthy start, moves the episode's updatedAt strictly forward without changing the library item's updatedAt, emits item_updated with the library item and answers the expanded library item; a non-string value, an unsupported key, a string publishedAt and invalid chapters are ignored.
Repeating the same PATCH leaves the episode's updatedAt unchanged and emits no item_updated, and answers the unchanged episode in the library item.

PATCH /api/podcasts/:id/episode/:episodeId answers 401 without a token, 403 for a user without update permission and for a user without access to the library, 404 for an unknown item before the permission check and for an episode that is not in the item, and 500 for a book item; a rejected request changes no row.
